Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting industrial development sites from specified land use regulations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to industrial development sites; adding a newsection to chapter 36.70A RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.21CRCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The individual prosperity of the people ofWashington is dependent on their ability to attract, support and retainprivate sector jobs that empower the economies of local communities.The Constitutions of the United States and Washington explicitlyenvision property owners being able to use their property in a mannerto provide such economic freedom and opportunity. It is essential tothe Washington state economy to encourage the location, operation, andcontinuing business viability of manufacturing businesses statewide andparticularly in rural municipal jurisdictions. It is the intent of thelegislature to streamline the permitting process for manufacturingbusinesses that will provide over one hundred jobs in rural communitiesacross the state. The location for new manufacturing businessopportunities will remain subject to applicable environmentalprotections under federal, state, and local laws dealing with water,air, flood control, historic preservation, zoning, and building codes.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The requirements of this chapter do not apply to and may notgovern the siting and development of industrial development sites. (2) For purposes of this section, "industrial development sites"are sites for specific manufacturing, industrial, or commercialbusinesses that will employ one hundred or more persons per site."Industrial development sites" may not be for the purpose of retailcommercial development or multitenant office parks.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Industrial development sites and government actions related tothe siting and development of industrial development sites are exemptedfrom compliance with this chapter. (2) For purposes of this section, "industrial development sites"has the same meaning as in section 2(2) of this act.
